title.narrative: Water and Environment Support (WES) in the ENI Southern Neighbourhood region.

description.narrative: The purposes of this contract are 1) to reduce the pollution reaching the Mediterranean Sea and 2) to strengthen the efficient use of water in urban and rural areas. To do so, the contractor will provide technical assistance and trainings to enforce the national regulatory frameworks, to foster the dialogue at national and regional level and to promote the exchange of best practices among various stakeholders.
